newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BROKERAGES PRE-TAX AT PLN 123 MLN IN Q1.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BROKERAGES PRE-TAX AT PLN 123 MLN IN Q1.

text.p: Poland's 50 brokerages operating in the first quarter of 1997 had a pre-tax profit of 123 million zlotys on 651.6-million-zloty revenues, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said in a report on Friday.
Fifty two brokerages operating in the similar period last year had a pre-tax profit of 44.5 million zlotys on 162.7 million zlotys revenues.
GUS said that 62 percent of the brokerages' revenues, or 405 million zlotys, come from operations on securites while 175.5 million zlots came from services.

The brokerages' total costs were 528.6 million zlotys in the first quarter. The brokerages serviced 1.1 million accounts in the first quarter of 1997, seven percent more than in the fourth quarter last year.
